summary: Silicon Valley Acquisition Corp. (SVAQ), a SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting a first amendment to its business combination agreement with EigenQ, Inc. and its merger subsidiary. The amendment permits transfer of Transaction Support Shares for any business-combination-related purpose, confirms redemption timing for public shares, expands the post-combination board from 7 to 9 members, and clarifies the equity incentive plan reserve at 10% of outstanding shares. Terms like price per share or premium were not specified. The transaction involves a domestication to Delaware and a merger, with the closing pending shareholder approval and regulatory conditions.
